title: MailAgentReplyResult
description: mail.agent.reply-result@1: what mail.agent.reply answers once the mail server took the message. `sent` is false when the mail server refused it (the answer's `reason` says why in plain words) and true when it accepted it — a relay's later bounce is not knowable here and is not claimed. `message_id` is the mail server's id for the sent message when it answers with one; `rfc_message_id` is the Message-ID header the reply carries, which a later letter in the thread will name in its In-Reply-To.

sent.description: True when the mail server accepted the reply, false when it did not.

message_id.description: The mail server's id for the sent message.

rfc_message_id.description: The Message-ID header of the reply, without angle brackets.

reason.description: Why the reply was not sent, in plain words. Null when sent is true.
